title: magnetic round tip bottle openers
text: magnetic round tip bottle openers. You get a set of 2.  They are brittle black plastic with metal (like) pieces for opening.  Two issues. 1. They don't stay on (fall off at the slightest touch) and they are super super sharp at places.  To be honest, I tossed these and stuck with the old school round end/pointy end openers - they stay on and don't cut you when you pick them up.  One star because I can't give them zero stars - but in all honesty they do open bottles - just wear gloves when you use them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful - however, I did toss these.
